eyebrow: APIs & JSON for AI Applications · Chapter 2, Lesson 10
subtitle: The mistakes that trip up even experienced developers

code:
{"name": "Ada", "role": "admin",}   // invalid: trailing comma

{'name': 'Ada'}                       // invalid: single quotes
{"name": "Ada"}                       // valid: double quotes
caption: Both look harmless. Both fail the moment you parse them.

eyebrow: Large numbers can silently lose precision
code:
{"id": 9007199254740993}   // may round in a 64-bit float

{"id": "9007199254740993"} // fix: send it as a string
caption: Exact large IDs travel as strings, not numbers.

eyebrow: null vs. a missing key — not the same
code:
{"nickname": null}   // key exists, value explicitly nothing
{}                    // key doesn't exist at all
caption: data.get("nickname") returns None for both — that can hide a real difference.
